title: Remove Sub-Folders from the Filesystem
sourceKind: third-party mirrors via web search (official page not fetchable)
summary: Given folder paths, return the list with every sub-folder removed, in any order. A sub-folder begins with its parent path followed by '/'.
officialConstraints: 1 to 40,000 entries; each path 2 to 100 characters; lowercase letters and '/' only, starting with '/'; folder names unique.
visualizationNotes: Visualization accepts up to 64 paths. Output is returned in sorted order.
